summary.short_summary: Joe Levine is preparing to sell his boutique automotive retail marketing agency after 23 years, prioritizing a fair valuation and a seamless transition to spend more time with his family, especially following the birth of his grandson. He seeks a straightforward cash sale, rejecting complicated financing options, and values his company's legacy over maximizing the sale price. With a current valuation around $1.2 million, he is comfortable with a 3x EBITDA multiple and acknowledges the impact of the automotive retail downturn on revenue. Joe has empowered his team of 13, including his wife, to manage operations effectively, which he believes will ensure continuity during the sale process. Market dynamics suggest varied buyer profiles, and a structured six-month timeline for the sale process has been established, with clear financial and legal considerations in mind.
